purpose: Develop a second local attack using the rule and target diagnosis, preserve v1, and generate validated predictions for all 22 opponents.
baseline: M/v1: full_reference_aia, with the same independently established private-negative mask
aia_hypothesis: Very small sex/prefecture blocks can make the reference lookup unusable. A data-dependent fallback can help, but must also be tested when prefecture retains useful correspondence.
mia_hypothesis: Cross-target median subtraction may remove candidate-specific background difficulty without forcing a target assignment. Improvement is judged on low-FPR ground-truth scores, not reduced overlap alone.

additional_development_check.reason: Initial joint worlds reuse noncandidate source donors across targets much more than the contest allocation, potentially favoring cross-target centering.
additional_development_check.comparison: Keep the development-selected MIA strength and baseline fixed, and compare them in additional development worlds with independently synthesized noncandidate fillers.
additional_development_check.label: Development robustness stress check; not an untouched final holdout
additional_development_check.limits: Zero shared synthetic fillers and heavily reused source fillers bracket two different approximations; neither reconstructs every true pairwise block.

selection_order: Specify component candidates, development and check seeds before scoring
Run development only, retain every candidate result
Audit model and evaluation, run meaningful invariance and reference tests
Freeze both selected components, shared dependencies and settings
Run selected methods and fixed v1 baselines on the final-check draws
Record results without post-check parameter tuning
Generate every real prediction twice and validate exact IDs and bytes
inference_inputs: Only contest C, public background, own candidates, public challenge QI and public settings. Exact self-challenge deductions are isolated in M/v1/actual.py.
constraints: Keep all distributed C rows including suspected imputation and background-donor rows
Do not force exactly 25-27 positives or assign every person to an opponent
Do not force all unknown rare candidates to belong to participating opponents
Do not assume cross-team challenge county/sex composition is equal
Do not enforce unverified age-bin half-membership constraints
evaluation_limits: Public-background people are used as shadow source and own B as shadow background, reversing the real roles
Previously used person partitions remain previously used despite fresh sampling seeds
Generated anonymization styles and their mixture are not known real opponent methods
AIA phi is unknown and is not borrowed from team10
MIA attack-success scores are not the multi-attacker anonymity aggregation
MIA and AIA component experiments are reported separately, not added as a forecast of official total score
